channel.title: TGA - Alerts
channel.description: See and search our full list of safety and medicine shortage alerts and market actions (including recalls, product alerts and product corrections).

item.title: CAROTONE skin-brightening products found to contain undeclared prescription-only medicine
item.description: We are advising consumers that CAROTONE products marketed for skin brightening may pose a serious risk to your health and should not be used.

item.title: Melanotan II tanning peptide products found to be inconsistently dosed
item.description: TGA is warning consumers against using Melanotan II tanning products.

item.title: Substitutions available for shortage of Dapsone 25 mg tablets
item.description: Dapsone 50 mg tablets can be supplied and halved during the shortage.

item.title: GLP-1 RAs and rare, but severe, eye disorders
item.description: Product warnings across the GLP-1 RA class of medicines have been updated due to the potential for these products to cause a rare, but severe, form of eye disorder.

item.title: Key Sun Kids Homeopathic Products
item.description: Key Sun Laboratories Pty Ltd is recalling 13 batches of Key Sun Kids Homeopathic Products, due to the risk of a small metal wire being present in the lozenge.

item.title: Performance concerns identified with TouchBio Chlamydia and Gonorrhoea self-test
item.description: TGA reviewed the TouchBio Chlamydia & Gonorrhoea self-test (for females) to verify its performance.

item.title: Counterfeit 'honey' sachets for sexual enhancement
item.description: We are advising consumers that sexual enhancement products labelled as ‘honey’ may pose a serious risk to your health and should not be taken.

item.title: Herbal preparations containing Withania somnifera (Withania, Ashwagandha)
item.description: Cases of liver injury associated with herbal preparations containing Withania somnifera, commonly known as Ashwagandha, continue to be reported both in Australia and internationally.

item.title: Unapproved SARMs found to be significantly underdosed
item.description: We are advising that Eagle Research Lab branded selective androgen receptor modulators (SARMs) pose a serious risk to your health and should not be taken.

item.title: Aidacare Aspire A205 Aluminium Patient Lifter
item.description: Aidacare Pty Ltd has updated the Instructions for Use (IFU) for the Aspire A205 Aluminium Patient Lifter. The IFU has been enhanced to strengthen existing instructions around correct and incorrect sling attachment methods and pre-use checks.

item.title: ITCHA SSS capsules
item.description: We are advising consumers that ITCHA SSS capsules, marketed for weight management, have been found to contain oxedrine, an undisclosed prescription-only medicine.

item.title: Grakcu capsules
item.description: We are advising consumers that Grakcu capsules may pose a serious risk to your health and should not be taken.

item.title: Sexual enhancement supplements found to contain undeclared prescription medicines
item.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) is advising consumers that several sexual enhancement products have been found to contain undeclared ingredients and may pose a serious risk to your health.

item.title: Creon (pancreatic extract) capsules shortage extended
item.description: Supply constraints will continue until 31 January 2027.

item.title: Unapproved ibutamoren capsules (MK-677) found to contain undisclosed anabolic steroid
item.description: We are advising consumers that ‘Pharmatech’ branded MK-677 capsules (containing ibutamoren) may pose a serious risk to your health and should not be taken.

item.title: Nature’s Own Glucosamine Sulfate with Chondroitin and Nature’s Own Magnesium Glycinate 1150mg
item.description: Sanofi-Aventis Healthcare Pty Ltd T/A Sanofi Consumer Healthcare, is recalling the below products due to the potential presence of a glass fragment within the bottle (not within the tablets).

item.title: BeneHeart D1 AED: Non-rechargeable public automated external defibrillator
item.description: Mindray Medical Australia Pty Ltd is conducting a product correction for the BeneHeart D1 Automated External Defibrillator. The operator’s manual is being updated for the procedure of switching patient types.

item.title: Benpen (benzylpenicillin sodium) injection products to be discontinued
item.description: Progressive discontinuation of all products will start with the 600 mg strength from 30 November 2026.

item.title: Dexcom G7 Sensors
item.description: AA-Med Pty Ltd is recalling two lots of Dexcom G7 sensors. These lots were identified for disposal and destruction in the USA due to incomplete sterilisation and deployment failure during testing.

item.title: TGA warning on the risks of importing unapproved peptide products
item.description: We are warning consumers about the risks of importing and using unapproved peptide products that are promoted online.

item.title: Intravenous (IV) fluids supply is stable
item.description: The acute national shortages of IV fluids have resolved.

item.title: Extension of substitution approval for shortage of Catapres (clonidine) 150 mcg tablets
item.description: Serious Scarcity Substitution Instrument (SSSI) has lapsed and product is available.

item.title: Overseas-registered products available for cyclophosphamide and ifosfamide injection shortages
item.description: Information about the cyclophosphamide and ifosfamide injection shortages.

item.title: Shortage of methylphenidate hydrochloride products is resolving
item.description: The overall supply of methylphenidate modified-release products continues to improve and stabilise.

item.title: Artri Ajo King tablets
item.description: We are advising consumers that Artri Ajo King tablets may pose a serious risk to your health and should not be taken.

item.title: Flixotide and Pavtide Accuhalers
item.description: GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) Australia Pty Ltd is issuing a product correction for certain batches of their Flixotide and Pavtide Accuhalers as a small number of Accuhalers may not automatically reload the next dose.

item.title: Understanding your responsibilities when importing, compounding and supplying unapproved peptide products
item.description: We are concerned about the rise in the import, supply, compounding and advertising of unapproved peptide products and the potential safety risks associated with these goods.

item.title: Medik8 Physical Sunscreen SPF50+ 60mL, 60mL Professional and 15mL
item.description: AC Newco Pty Ltd (Advanced Cosmeceuticals), on behalf of Medik8, is recalling all unexpired batches of Medik8 Physical Sunscreen SPF50+ 60mL, 60mL Professional, & 15mL due to the product being unlikely to meet its labelled Sun Protection Factor (SPF) rating.

item.title: ACCOLADE single chamber (SR), dual chamber (DR) standard life (SL) and DR extended life (EL) pacemakers; and VISIONIST cardiac resynchronization therapy pacemakers (CRT-Ps)
item.description: Boston Scientific is conducting a Product correction and Product alert for ACCOLADE and VISIONIST pacemakers.

item.title: TRUE METRIX® Blood Glucose Monitoring Systems
item.description: The former liquidator for Trividia Health Australia Pty Ltd (deregistered) is facilitating a product correction for TRUE METRIX® Blood Glucose Monitoring Systems.

item.title: Rifton TRAM and E-Pacer patient transfer and gait training devices
item.description: Apex Mobility is conducting a product correction on the Rifton TRAM and E-Pacer patient transfer and gait training mobility devices.

item.title: Counterfeit weight loss products claiming to contain GLP-1
item.description: We are issuing an updated safety advisory after testing confirmed counterfeit imported weight loss products.

item.title: Shortage of Zimstat (simvastatin) 5 mg tablets and substitution approval extended
item.description: We have extended the SSSI in response to the ongoing shortage

item.title: Comvita MediHoney Antibacterial Wound Gel 25g & 50g
item.description: Comvita Australia Pty Ltd is recalling certain batches of Comvita MediHoney Antibacterial Wound Gel due to problems with the packaging.

item.title: Natures Valley Collagen Builder tablets
item.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) is advising consumers that Natures Valley Collagen Builder tablets may pose a serious risk to your health and should not be taken.

item.title: H3 Hintermann Ankle Replacement System
item.description: The TGA has concerns about an increased risk of revision as shown in the Australian Orthopaedic Association National Joint Replacement Registry (AOANJRR) data when compared to other fixed and mobile bearing systems.

item.title: Banana Boat Baby Zinc Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50+ and Hawaiian Tropic Mineral Zinc Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50+
item.description: Edgewell Personal Care Australia Pty Ltd is recalling all unexpired batches (nine in total) due to the potential for the lotions to become separated.

item.title: Solar Screen Mineral Zinc Hydrating Face and Body Sunscreen Lotion SPF50+
item.description: Gem Care Products Pty Ltd is recalling all unexpired batches (two in total) due to the potential for the lotions to become separated.

item.title: Safety concerns over imported counterfeit melatonin products
item.description: We are issuing an updated safety advisory regarding imported counterfeit unregistered melatonin products.

item.title: BeneHeart C Series AED: Non-rechargeable public automated external defibrillator
item.description: Mindray Medical Australia Pty Ltd is conducting a product correction for the BeneHeart C Series Automated External Defibrillator (AED).

item.title: New Presolol (labetalol) tablet shortage: substitution instrument and overseas-registered alternative approved
item.description: PRESOLOL 200 TABLET SHORTAGE HAS RESOLVED.

item.title: Continuing imports of counterfeit Botox vials
item.description: TGA continues to see imports of counterfeit Botox vials despite a previous warning issued in July 2025.

item.title: Substitution approval extended for HRT patch shortages
item.description: Serious Scarcity Substitution Instrument extended due to continued shortages of HRT patch products.

item.title: Anko Small and Large Gel Paks
item.description: Kmart Australia Ltd is recalling their Anko Small Gel Pak and Anko Large Gel Pak because they contain ethylene glycol, a toxic substance.

item.title: Substitutions approved for shortage of Catapres (clonidine) 150 mcg tablets
item.description: The initial Serious Scarcity Substitution Instrument (SSSI) has been extended - refer to new medicine shortage alert: "Extension of substitution approval for shortage of Catapres (clonidine) 150 mcg tablets"

item.title: Changes to the supply of insulin products
item.description: Pharmaceutical companies Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are discontinuing some of their insulin products.

item.title: CellAED: Non-rechargeable public automated external defibrillator
item.description: The company which has supplied the CellAED devices, RRR Manufacturing Pty Ltd, has gone into liquidation. The liquidators for RRR Manufacturing, are conducting a Critical Recall for all lots of the CellAED device.

item.title: Shortage of Creon (pancreatic extract) capsules extended
item.description: Supply constraints will apply to Creon 25,000 unit and 35,000 unit capsules until 30 June 2026.

item.title: Key Sun Kids Travel Sickness Homeopathic Product
item.description: Key Sun Laboratories Pty Ltd is recalling one batch of Key Sun Kids Travel Sickness Homeopathic Product, due to the risk of a small metal wire being present in the lozenge.

item.title: Manasamitra Vadakam tablets (Ayurvedic medicine)
item.description: Manasamitra Vakakam tablets pose a serious risk to your health and should not be taken.
